newsitem.title: USA: LPC - CST to tap banks for $550 mln securitization.
newsitem.headline: LPC - CST to tap banks for $550 mln securitization.

text.p: NEW YORK, Sept 10 (LPC) - Bankers expect a roughly $550 million securitization for Brazilian steel concern CST to come to market soon, market sources said.
Daiwa America Inc and Goldman, Sachs and Co are arranging that deal, and Unibanco and Banco Bozano will place the deal in Brazil, sources said.
Originally, bankers had expected the deal to run roughly $200 million. Price talk was not available.
A number of Brazilian steel securitization deals were heading for the market earlier this year, raising concerns about possible oversaturation, market sources added.

Indeed, several other bank deals with Brazilian steel concerns have emerged: Chase Manhattan arranged a $300 million securitization for CSN that was split between a fixed and floating-rate piece; Daiwa put together several deals for Acominas, and banks are still awaiting a mandate for $300 million deal for Usiminas, bankers added. However, few of these deals have hit market, easing bankers' concerns. --Meredith Coffey, LPC, 212-489-5455
